_comment: Corrections to the computed dates of Turkish religious holidays.
The generator derives the first day of each religious holiday from the Umm al-Qura
calendar, which has matched the dates Diyanet publishes for every recent year. It is
an astronomical approximation, though, not the authority: Diyanet's calendar and the
Resmi Gazete are. When a year diverges, record the correct first day here and the
Keys are Hijri years. 'ramazan' is 1 Shawwal, 'kurban' is 10 Dhu al-Hijjah, both as
